text_block_list.text:
...Number one in the world. The ultimate 
battlefield where unyielding pride clashed 
and sparks flew.

While generous applause rained down on the 
victor, <chrname> stood frozen upon the turf.
I rush over to <chrname>. And then, she—
—A fighting spirit ignited in those eyes.

<chrname> nods. She channels even her frustration 
into pure drive.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Let's take on the challenge, as 
many times as it takes.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"That is what we're here for. That is why 
Project L'Arc exists."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
—As long as you desire it, let's aim to be 
the best in the world.
